description: This Java class represents the ConceptStateConversion entity in the OpenMRS core API, mapping concept states to program workflows and workflow states, with annotations for auditing and standard property accessors.

classes.name: ConceptStateConversion
classes.description: Represents a conversion mapping between a concept and a specific state within a program workflow in OpenMRS.

properties.name: conceptStateConversionId
properties.description: Unique identifier for the ConceptStateConversion entity.

properties.name: concept
properties.description: The Concept associated with this conversion.

properties.name: programWorkflow
properties.description: The workflow in which this concept state exists.

properties.name: programWorkflowState
properties.description: The specific state within the program workflow.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the concept state conversion mapping.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the Concept associated with this conversion.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the Concept for this conversion.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversionId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of this conversion.

methods.name: setConceptStateConversionId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID for this conversion.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflow
methods.description: Returns the workflow associated with this conversion.

methods.name: getId
